# International Compliance Association (ICA)

> Leading professional body for the global regulatory and financial crime compliance community, offering qualifications, training, and membership for 30,000+ compliance professionals.

The ICA provides comprehensive professional development in anti-money laundering (AML), know-your-customer (KYC), financial crime prevention, and regulatory compliance. The organization awards university-recognized qualifications and serves both individual professionals and corporate teams through memberships, short courses, and tailored training programs.

## Key Topics

- Anti-Money Laundering (AML)
- Know-Your-Customer/Customer Due Diligence (KYC/CDD)
- Financial Crime Prevention
- Regulatory Compliance
- Professional Certifications
- Continuous Professional Development (CPD)
- Corporate Training
- Sanctions Risk Management
- Compliance Qualifications
- ICA Diplomas
- Professional Postgraduate Diplomas
- Cyber Security
- Risk Assessment
- Competence Development

## Professional Qualifications & Certifications

- [ICA Qualifications - Get #ICAqualified](https://www.int-comp.org/learn-and-develop/qualifications): ICA professional qualifications awarded with University of Manchester including certificates, diplomas, and postgraduate credentials
- [Learn and develop your knowledge on compliance, financial crime prevention, AML or managing sanctions risk](https://www.int-comp.org/learn-and-develop): ICA learning hub with qualifications in compliance, AML, financial crime, and sanctions
- [ICA Short Courses - Self-led and expert-led online courses](https://www.int-comp.org/learn-and-develop/short-courses): Online short courses on AML, KYC/CDD, financial crime, transaction monitoring
- [Subject Areas](https://www.int-comp.org/learn-and-develop/subject-areas): Training subject areas: AML, GRC, financial crime, KYC/CDD, cyber security
- [Studying with ICA](https://www.int-comp.org/learn-and-develop/studying-with-ica): Student resources and guidance for ICA qualification studies

## Membership & Professional Community

- [Become an ICA Member | Leading compliance community](https://www.int-comp.org/membership): ICA membership for 30,000 compliance professionals with exclusive benefits
- [Buy ICA Membership - Single and multi-year memberships](https://www.int-comp.org/membership/buy-membership): Purchase ICA Associate, Professional, Fellow memberships with benefits
- [ICA Corporate Membership | Leading compliance community](https://www.int-comp.org/membership/corporate-membership): Corporate membership for compliance teams with learning and certification tools

## Corporate Solutions & Training

- [Corporate solutions](https://www.int-comp.org/corporate-solutions): ICA corporate training and compliance solutions for regulatory teams
- [Corporate qualifications and training](https://www.int-comp.org/corporate-solutions/qualifications-and-training-for-your-teams): Tailored corporate compliance and financial crime training programs
- [Corporate products and services for your organisation](https://www.int-comp.org/corporate-solutions/solutions-to-help-you-manage-risk-more-effectively): Risk assessment and competence development products for organizations
- [ICA Apprenticeship Assessment](https://www.int-comp.org/corporate-solutions/apprenticeship-assessment-england): ICA assessment services for compliance and regulatory apprenticeships

## Events & Community Engagement

- [Events](https://www.int-comp.org/events): ICA conferences, webinars, and roundtables on financial crime and compliance
- [ICA Future of FinCrime & Compliance Summit](https://www.int-comp.org/events/ica-future-of-fincrime-compliance-summit): Annual ICA summit on financial crime prevention and compliance trends
- [ICA Webinars](https://www.int-comp.org/events/ica-webinars): 30+ annual expert-led webinars on compliance and CPD requirements
- [ICA Graduation Ceremony](https://www.int-comp.org/events/graduation-ceremony): ICA graduation celebration event for certificate and diploma holders
